projects.deadlineNote: Checked 29 Oct 2026: master's admission is rolling until places fill, with scholarship allocation subject to availability. projects.notes:
Confirmed interest in prior planning: a leading subject-fit option. Official programme is English, on-campus in Barcelona, 9 months / 60 ECTS. Funding remains the blocker. Current master's scholarships include Lasallian-alumni and academic/financial partial awards; eligibility and grade conversion must be assessed, not assumed. A partial tuition reduction is not a fully funded scholarship. Do not pay a booking deposit without a viable financing plan.

29 October 2026 official-source review:
Academic fit: software engineering/architecture, not a primarily statistics or model-training degree. Official Spanish programme title is Master Universitario en Desarrollo y Arquitectura de Software. English/on-campus Barcelona; 60 ECTS, nine months, 60 places, Tuesday–Thursday 19:00–22:00. Current intake page still gives 19 October 2026; do not infer October 2027 availability.
Curriculum: software design I/II; testing fundamentals; software architecture I/II; development principles/tools; software development models; agile methodologies; programming paradigms; unstructured databases; 10-ECTS final thesis. Methodology includes team projects and a company-defined final challenge, not a guaranteed paid placement.
Eligibility: CS graduates are an explicit target; non-EHEA degrees assessed for equivalent preparation and master's access. Programme-specific English test minimum and MOI acceptance not verified on the official requirements page; obtain written confirmation.
Published tuition is EUR 11,940 for 2026/27, not a verified 2027/28 quote. At that base price a 40% award leaves EUR 7,164 tuition, before living costs.
Funding: academic excellence awards 50% for accepted Spanish-equivalent GPA >=9.5 (2/programme), 40% >=8.5 (4/programme), 20% >=8 (3/programme). Grade conversion must be assessed; 85.6/100 is not automatically accepted as 8.56/10. Financial-support/Boost awards 10–40%. Lasallian-school alumni 10%; employment alone does not prove eligibility. Corporate agreement 15% requires an active FUNITEC agreement. Aid cannot be stacked. Casa de Mexico includes a full-tuition Software Architecture place, but requires Mexican nationality, so not applicable on known nationality. No applicable fully funded tuition-plus-living award identified.
Admission: rolling until places fill; upload passport and degree (CV useful), possible interview. Published response target eight days after complete documents; booking generally payable within 15 days of acceptance. Confirm 2027 tuition/intake, English/MOI policy, exact award eligibility, scholarship timing before deposit, and any external living-cost sponsorship before committing.
Sources: https://www.salleurl.edu/en/admissions/masters-admissions/admission-process ; https://www.salleurl.edu/en/admissions/masters/scholarship-program ; https://www.salleurl.edu/en/requirements-admission-masters-programmes
